answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Fieldbound stile maker dairy patent, and the stamp itself rests on a patent makers file after field reviews. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Before the stamp comes a fare of £14 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. harbor is written on the receipt. timber stays on the record. The clerk notes onyx.
